name: iac-cost-gate
description: Estimates the monthly AWS cost of Terraform HCL, a terraform show -json plan or a CloudFormation template you paste, flags waste (gp2 volumes, unattached IPs and volumes, Multi-AZ or oversized instances outside prod, log groups that never expire, missing cost tags and more) and returns a pass, warn or fail verdict against an optional monthly limit. Every number is computed in code from a static on-demand price table (as of 2026-11, estimate +/-30%) and every assumption is listed. A plan JSON gets a before/after delta. Follow-ups: only the violations, cost table, set limit $300, assume 500 GB through NAT, region eu-west-1, as json. It never needs credentials, never scans an account and never blocks anything itself; it answers nothing outside the pasted infrastructure code.

skills.name: IaC cost check
skills.description: Monthly cost estimate, waste-rule violations and a pass/warn/fail verdict for pasted Terraform, plan JSON or CloudFormation, with every assumption listed.
examples: Cost check this Terraform, limit $500: <paste the .tf files>
Estimate the delta of this plan: <paste terraform show -json output>
